name: swissquote-wallet
description: Swissquote Wallet Challenge (EPFL, Oct 2026) - self-custody wallet prototype

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,cosigner,recovery -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @sqw/web dev" "pnpm --filter @sqw/cosigner dev" "pnpm --filter @sqw/recovery-provider dev"
